dedupe_keys.name: ampds2 almanac of minutely power dataset

description: AMPds2 is a two-year record of electricity, water and natural-gas consumption in a single monitored home, published by Simon Fraser University. It contains 21 electricity meters, two water meters and two gas meters, with 1,051,200 observations per meter from April 2012 through March 2014. The repository adds appliance-use annotations, utility bills and hourly weather from the YVR station, including climate normals for 1981–2010. Harvard Dataverse provides tab-delimited tables, an HDF5 package and supporting equipment documents. Its terms explicitly state CC BY 4.0 despite the structured licence field being empty, and access is free. The resource can calibrate household utility-demand models and building digital twins, with cross-resource interactions beyond the electricity-only focus of data-uk-dale-domestic-appliance-level-electricity. A caveat is that one household cannot represent a population without additional sampling assumptions. Meter intervals and weather intervals also differ, so aligned analyses need an explicit aggregation rule. No meter files or equipment PDFs were downloaded.
